About the Hospital

A Panchakarma centre built on Kerala's original methods

Sri Veda Sushruta Ayurveda Hospital was founded to bring the disciplined, time-tested Panchakarma tradition of Kerala to patients seeking real, lasting relief — not a spa experience, but classical clinical Ayurveda.

Every treatment plan begins with a physician consultation and Prakriti (constitution) assessment, followed by therapies performed with medicated oils and herbs prepared in our own pharmacy, largely sourced from Kerala.

Physician-Led CareEvery plan is designed and reviewed by a qualified Ayurvedic doctor.
Authentic SourcingOils, choornams and kashayams prepared using Kerala-tradition recipes.
Inpatient & OutpatientDay therapies as well as extended residential Panchakarma programs.
Post-Care GuidanceDiet, lifestyle and follow-up plans tailored to your constitution.

Our Physician

Dr. Mahesh Kumar. S

MD (Ayu) · Panchakarma Specialist · Authorised Medical Officer, ISRO · 15+ Years of Clinical Experience

Dr. Mahesh Kumar. S has spent over 15 years specialising in Panchakarma and classical Kerala therapies, treating chronic joint and spine conditions, neurological disorders, stress-related illness, and lifestyle diseases using authentic detoxification and rejuvenation protocols.

Trained in traditional Kerala Ayurvedic institutions, he combines classical diagnostic methods — Nadi Pariksha and Prakriti analysis — with structured, closely monitored treatment courses, personally overseeing every patient's therapy plan from consultation to recovery. He serves as Authorised Medical Officer to ISRO, and was honoured with the Dhanvantari Puraskar in recognition of his contribution to Ayurvedic medicine.

Panchakarma Treatments

The five classical actions of detoxification

Panchakarma is a structured sequence of purification therapies. Dr. Mahesh Kumar designs each course individually, based on your constitution and condition.

01

Vamana

Therapeutic emesis to clear excess Kapha and respiratory or skin-related imbalances.

02

Virechana

Medicated purgation for Pitta-driven conditions — skin, liver and digestive disorders.

03

Vasti

Herbal and oil enemas, considered the cornerstone therapy for Vata disorders and joint conditions.

04

Nasya

Nasal administration of medicated oils for sinus, head and neurological conditions.

05

Raktamokshana

Controlled blood purification therapy used selectively for chronic skin conditions.

06

Purvakarma

Preparatory Snehana (oleation) and Swedana (fomentation) that prime the body for Panchakarma.

From the Kerala Tradition

Signature therapies, prepared the classical way

Beyond Panchakarma, our therapists are trained in Kerala's specialised treatment forms — each performed with fresh herbal oils and prescribed durations, exactly as practiced in Kerala's traditional centres.

Every course is prescribed by Dr. Mahesh Kumar and monitored throughout, so intensity and duration stay matched to your condition.

  • Abhyanga — Full body oil massage അഭ്യംഗം
  • Njavara Kizhi — Medicated rice-bolus therapy ഞവരക്കിഴി
  • Elakizhi — Herbal leaf-bundle fomentation ഇലക്കിഴി
  • Sirodhara — Continuous oil stream to the forehead ശിരോധാര
  • Pizhichil — Warm oil bath therapy പിഴിച്ചിൽ
  • Udvartana — Herbal powder massage ഉദ്വർത്തനം
  • Kati Vasti — Localised lower-back oil pooling കടി വസ്തി
